title: Deinterlacing
text: Remove interlacing effect, 1 input, 1 output, {Method} sets Deinterlacing method Line; {Input image is transposed (data order is row major)}, {Rounding mode}, {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the overflow mode, {Accumulator}, {Output} sets the data type for output Same and {Lock data type settings against change by the fixed-point tools} sets the data type override. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Interlaced input numeric matrix | 3-D numeric array | image | video

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Deinterlaced output numeric matrix | 3-D numeric array | image | video

params.name: Method
params.values: Deinterlacing method Line repetition (default) | Linear interpolation | Vertical temporal median filtering

params.name: Input image is transposed (data order is row major)
Rounding mode
params.values: Rounding mode for calculating fixed-point value Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Accumulator
params.values: Accumulator data type Binary point scaling (default) | Same as input

params.name: Output
params.values: Data type for output Same as input (default) | Binary point scaling

params.name: Lock data type settings against change by the fixed-point tools
